title: Timeouts, retries, and backoff with jitter
author: Marc Brooker, Amazon Builders' Library
why: The clearest explanation of why retries at every layer multiply load, and how backoff, jitter and retry limits fix it. Applies directly to LLM gateways.

title: Addressing Cascading Failures (Site Reliability Engineering, chapter 22)
author: Google SRE
why: Retry budgets, deadlines and graceful degradation from the people who popularised them; read it with a model provider as the overloaded backend.

title: Efficient Guided Generation for Large Language Models
author: Brandon T. Willard and Rémi Louf (2023)
why: How constrained decoding turns a regex or JSON Schema into a finite-state machine over the vocabulary, the idea behind the Outlines library.

title: LangSmith Observability
author: LangChain
why: Tracing every LLM and tool call with inputs, outputs, latency and cost, which is how you debug retries, fallbacks and malformed output in production.
